item.title: Funding agreed for new village hall
item.description: A senior councillor says plans for a new, modern community hall will help “unify” an expanding Nottinghamshire village. Bilsthorpe Parish Council has been looking to develop modern community facilities in the village for a number of years in a bid to “meet the needs of a growing and expanding community”. item.description: A council leader says the changes he has made to his top team after just nine months will help to make £44 million in savings. item.description: Three people have been arrested on suspicion of drug offences after police found crack cocaine, mamba and a knife in Nottingham city centre. item.title: Plans for huge 420-bed development submitted next to railyard
item.description: Plans have been submitted for 420 homes next to a railyard in a part of Nottinghamshire.
